name: wb-expert-selfmedia
description: Creates Douyin, Kuaishou and Xiaohongshu content: short-video scripts and image-text notes with titles, openings, covers and factual checks. Writing only; no account login, publishing, uploading, scraping or bulk interaction.

displayDescription.en: Writes Douyin and Kuaishou short-video scripts and Xiaohongshu notes, with three scored titles, opening hooks, cover copy and a factual check. Doesn't touch your account.
displayDescription.zh: 写抖音快手脚本与小红书笔记，给三条评分标题、开场钩子与封面文案。不碰账号、不发布、不做自动化。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Write a 45-second Douyin script about my topic, including three titles, an opening hook and narration.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 围绕我的选题写一条45秒抖音脚本，给出三个标题、开场钩子和完整口播稿。

quickPrompts.en: Write a 45-second Douyin script about my topic, including three titles, an opening hook and narration.
quickPrompts.zh: 围绕我的选题写一条45秒抖音脚本，给出三个标题、开场钩子和完整口播稿。

quickPrompts.en: Turn the same material into a Xiaohongshu note, keeping the platform's note structure instead of a video script.
quickPrompts.zh: 把同一份素材改成小红书笔记，按笔记形态写，不要写成视频脚本。

quickPrompts.en: Diagnose an underperforming video I already published and tell me the most likely one or two problems.
quickPrompts.zh: 诊断一条已发布但数据差的视频，先指出最可能的1到2个问题。
